brief:
Here's your Relay Brief for Friday, October sixteenth.

You have fifteen accounts. Six need you this week, and the record is wrong about four of them. Every one of those four says renewal in negotiation or verbal. None has anything in writing.

Run now. Keeler and Roth. Eighty eight thousand in annual recurring revenue, a renewal date past in the record, and procurement asked for a competitive quote two weeks ago. Nobody escalated it. Your champion is on leave until January. Call the Director of Knowledge Management today and get in front of procurement before the quote lands.

Expand. Halden Freight. Usage up thirty four percent in thirty days, and a business unit lead asked for four hundred more seats and never heard back. Renewal is forty one days out. Call Dana Whitlock, get introduced to the Vice President of Operations, and bring the expansion and the renewal as one conversation.

Watch. Cobalt Shore. The champion left in August, two service credits were approved and never applied, and the new Head of Claims Tech has ignored two emails. Apply the credits before they ask.

Record flag. Tideline Robotics. The stage says verbal. The notes say a competitor was named and nobody chased it.

Three actions. Call Keeler and Roth procurement. Book Halden's Vice President. Apply Cobalt Shore's credits.

That's your Relay. Go run your leg.
